name: nation-of-elites
description: A complete 74-agent AI workforce organized like a real IT company, aligned with Claude Opus 5 (orchestration & hard reasoning) and Claude Sonnet 5 (default workhorse — 1M context; Haiku not used). Runs in Claude Code (CLI, Desktop, IDE) and Claude Cowork. 12 divisions including executive leadership, strategic planning, engineering, QA, SecOps, AI/ML, mobile, construction AI, content & localization, and business development. Features persistent memory, 33 skills with preloading (including humanizer), official plugin integrations, /loop recurring tasks, delegation discipline for Opus 5, and Agent Teams support.
